summary: Frontend-only mobile header/nav regression after login-link visibility fix. Ran 29 UI assertions across mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x800) covering logged-out state, admin login, customer login, hamburger menu contents, navigation targets, menu auto-close, overflow, desktop hidden mobile-only block, and console-error regression on /menu, /just-hungry, /checkout. All 29 passed.

issues: Event / delivery date & time uses browser-native datetime-local picker (mm/dd/yyyy, --:-- --) instead of a shadcn/custom calendar component; inconsistent UX across browsers and locales.

action_items: Optional: replace browser-native datetime-local input on /checkout with a shadcn Calendar + time picker for consistent UX.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js Header is defined on a single very long line (line 16) — hard to maintain; consider moving Header + other components into their own files. App.js overall is a monolith (many components inlined).
Auth submit does not handle loading state; a double-tap could submit twice.
console errors show two harmless 401s from /auth/me on first load when logged out — expected but noisy; consider silencing via a lightweight status check.
